meta.title: Org Talent Match
meta.description: Adds a "Talent match" entry to the left sidebar. The project guide shows searchable project progress, outcomes and recent projects, plus blocker/difficulty/change alerts synced from feedback; record feedback by pasting one block of text, which is parsed locally into project outcomes and alerts; a desktop memo per project can feed the paste box. It also includes the requirement pool, one DSH conversation per project, the talent pool, organization chart, team matching, capability advice and skill research. Import CSV, TSV, JSON, Markdown or XLSX. Local data stays in this browser; task details are sent to DSH conversations by explicit user action, and skill-search keywords go to GitHub.
